description: Siemens TIA Portal V21 automation harness: the `tia` MCP server (Openness over the PLCWare serve API), the skills and the operating guide (gates, guards, gotchas).

settings.name: PLCWare API URL
settings.description: URL of the serve API that drives TIA Portal. Leave empty to use http://localhost:5000 (editor and serve on the same machine); use http://<vm-ip>:5000 for a remote Windows host.
